verdict.rationale: Greptile is itself an AI agent, and users hand it scoped tasks: automatic PR review, generated unit tests and diagrams, runtime sandbox testing via TREX, and on-demand reviews via `greptile review`. Community reports also show users asking it codebase questions. Delegation stops at review and validation, though: actual fixes are handed off to external agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Devin) rather than done by a built-in assistant, and that external hand-off earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant that accepts open-ended tasks, built-in execution of fixes or changes, and recent hands-on corroboration of task delegation.
